summary: Two reconciler wakes are named in /v1/performance's reconciler_wakes: a completed background launch identity measurement now counts as a `launch identity` wake (it notified the reconciler without being counted), and a replication receive that wakes it is counted under the claim kind it brought most of, as API claim wakes are. OpenTelemetry's closed wake registry gains `launch_identity` (18 values)

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: What wakes the reconciler, and when, is unchanged; only how a wake is counted changes. A waking replication receive runs one more read of the kinds it brought.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version safe: no wire, client or stored-format change. A collector that reads st.reconcile.wakes or st.reconcile.wake_cause can see the new closed value `launch_identity`; older daemons never emit it.

recovery.detail: Rolling back counts identity measurement wakes nowhere again and replication receive wakes without a kind.
